_note: Add-in registry. 'connection': builtin = works inside Author's Hand; api = live API connection; deeplink = opens the tool pre-filled with the article title/DOI/query; exchange = send/receive the project's articles as BibTeX/RIS. URL formats of third-party sites can change; edit them here.

tools.name: OpenAlex
tools.what: 250M+ works, citations, topics, journals — powers search, citation map and auto-refresh.

tools.name: Semantic Scholar
tools.what: AI search, TL;DRs and open-access PDFs (built into search).

tools.name: Google Scholar
tools.what: Broadest coverage; check 'cited by' counts and versions.

tools.name: Consensus
tools.what: Answers yes/no research questions with a consensus meter.

tools.name: Elicit
tools.what: Systematic-review style screening and data extraction tables.

tools.name: scite
tools.what: Smart citations: supporting vs contrasting evidence.

tools.name: CORE
tools.what: Largest open-access full-text aggregator.

tools.name: BASE
tools.what: Repository search incl. theses and grey literature.

tools.name: PubMed
tools.what: Biomedical and health literature.

tools.name: Citation Map (built-in)
tools.what: Litmaps-style map of seed articles, their references and citing papers by year and impact.

tools.name: Litmaps
tools.what: Seed maps & monitoring. Export this project's BibTeX/RIS → Litmaps ‘Import’; export a Litmaps map as BibTeX/RIS → import here.

tools.name: Connected Papers
tools.what: Similarity graph from one seed paper.

tools.name: ResearchRabbit
tools.what: Collections, author networks; import via BibTeX/RIS or Zotero sync.

tools.name: Inciteful
tools.what: Citation-network analysis; paste DOIs or upload BibTeX.

tools.name: Paper Reader & Chat (built-in)
tools.what: Structured summary, evidence trail, chat with citations, cheatsheet.

tools.name: SciSpace
tools.what: Copilot to explain papers, extract tables, literature review grids.

tools.name: ChatPDF
tools.what: Upload a PDF and chat with it.

tools.name: Semantic Reader
tools.what: Augmented PDF reader with in-line citation cards.

tools.name: Writing Studio (built-in)
tools.what: Stage-wise drafts, gap matrix, conceptual model, RQs and hypotheses from your selected articles.

tools.name: Paperpal
tools.what: Academic language editing and submission readiness checks.

tools.name: Writefull
tools.what: Academic phrasing, abstract and title generation.

tools.name: Grammarly
tools.what: Grammar and clarity checks.

tools.name: QuillBot
tools.what: Paraphrasing support (always cite the source).

tools.name: Overleaf
tools.what: LaTeX writing; upload the project .bib.

tools.name: Zotero
tools.what: Push selected articles to your Zotero library (user ID + API key) or exchange RIS.

tools.name: Mendeley
tools.what: Import the project RIS/BibTeX.

tools.name: EndNote
tools.what: Import the project .enw/.ris file.

tools.name: JabRef
tools.what: Open-source BibTeX manager.

tools.name: JANE (Journal/Author Name Estimator)
tools.what: Paste your title/abstract to find matching journals (biomedical focus).

tools.name: Elsevier JournalFinder
tools.what: Paste title + abstract.

tools.name: Springer Nature Journal Suggester
tools.what: Paste title + abstract.

tools.name: Wiley Journal Finder
tools.what: Paste title + abstract.

tools.name: Web of Science Manuscript Matcher
tools.what: Matches WoS-indexed journals.

tools.name: Journal Fit (built-in)
tools.what: Ranks venues by similarity to your abstract using your record and live search.

tools.name: Rapid Journal Quality Check (built-in)
tools.what: DOAJ, OpenAlex metrics, Crossref, your Scopus/ABDC/UGC-CARE lists, red-flag heuristics → score.

tools.name: SCImago Journal Rank
tools.what: SJR, quartiles, h-index by subject category.

tools.name: Scopus Sources
tools.what: Check coverage and CiteScore; download the source list (CSV) to load into the quality check.

tools.name: WoS Master Journal List
tools.what: Web of Science coverage (SCIE/SSCI/ESCI).

tools.name: UGC-CARE List
tools.what: Indian UGC-CARE journal list (load an exported list into the quality check).

tools.name: ABDC Journal Quality List
tools.what: A*/A/B/C ratings for business journals (load the downloadable list).

tools.name: DOAJ
tools.what: Legitimate open-access journal index (checked automatically).

tools.name: Think. Check. Submit.
tools.what: Predatory-journal checklist.

tools.name: Retraction check (built-in)
tools.what: Flags retracted works in your project (OpenAlex is_retracted).

tools.name: G*Power
tools.what: A-priori sample size / power analysis.

tools.name: SmartPLS
tools.what: PLS-SEM for testing the conceptual model.

tools.name: JASP
tools.what: Free statistics (frequentist & Bayesian).

tools.name: Google Colab
tools.what: Python notebooks for ML models.
